text:
Address: http://127.0.0.1:37205/
Title: What a scan reads
Pointer: not yet over the page
The page shows 17,244 files before any ignore rules are applied. I'll choose "Use" so the scan follows the folder's own ignore files, then check the new counts.

Address: http://127.0.0.1:37205/
Title: What a scan reads
Pointer: 1090, 139

With the folder's own ignore files applied, the scan will read **15,593 files** and leave out **1,651**. Those are the numbers after I clicked "Use" on the 25 .gitignore and 15 .tfignore files the page found. Before that, the scan would have read all 17,244 files.

The 1,651 excluded files are the ones matched by the folder's ignore rules. They are mostly build output: 666 .dll, 225 .pdb, and 208 .xml files, across 43 folders. I haven't clicked Scan, so the page's counts are the only figures I have.
